### **1. Financial Inputs from the Context:**

  $$\text{DIO} = 365 \times \frac{\text{Average Inventory}}{\text{FY2019 COGS}} = 365 \times \frac{1,600.75}{11,108.4} = 52.5835 \text{ days}$$

### **3. Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC):**
